propositions: rebar must not use git stash push/pop/drop in the tickets worktree because the stash stack is repository-global and shared across all worktrees, allowing a stash created in one worktree to be popped into the ticket store

the push.py stash->merge->pop dance can pop a foreign stash from a different source worktree into the tickets index, leaving unmerged entries and corrupting the store when source files are applied to the tickets branch
the tickets store must be mutated exclusively through rebar's event-append API, never through ad-hoc git operations, requiring a supported maintenance entrypoint with backup refs and audit trails
a stranded index with unmerged foreign paths (files not tracked on origin/tickets and not ticket-shaped) must be auto-healed by classifying and discarding them rather than wedging every store write
the supported tracker-maintenance entrypoint must refuse to proceed when unpushed ticket commits exist and must create backup refs before the first write to prevent event loss
a break-glass --force override must exist for genuinely unforeseen cases, requiring an explicit written reason and loud audit recording
